🧵 Big weekend at galaxymind.space.

The vendor directory grew real circular-economy primitives. Here's everything that shipped:

1/ Every vendor now has their own page at galaxymind.space/v/[handle]

Custom OG card with the vendor's brand. LocalBusiness schema (paymentAccepted: Bitcoin + Lightning).

Their listing is now a real online presence, not just a row in a table.

2/ Click any vendor on the directory and a magnified popup opens — you stay on Galaxy Mind.

Use ←/→ to flip through vendors like a slide deck. Esc to close.

The bouncing-off-on-first-click problem is solved.

3/ Vendors can now signal what they're "Open to trade for"

Example: @IxTechCrypto sells Bitaxe miners and would barter them for consumables or apparel.

First concrete hook in the circular economy direction.

4/ Vendors silent on Nostr >30 days auto-tuck away from the front page (instead of being featured-of-the-week).

They reappear when they post again. Their /v/[slug] page stays live with a "currently quiet" banner.

Reversible, no irreversible deletes.

5/ New this week 🇩🇪🇺🇸:

· @Bitaxeshop — Bitaxe miners shipped from Germany
· @IxTechCrypto — Bitaxe + Nerdaxe + 3D-printed accessories + laser-etched art
· @GingerSherpa — BlockTron LED Bitcoin price ticker

Bitcoin home-hardware is having a moment.

6/ Vendor onboarding is now an interactive CLI that auto-pulls profile data from Nostr (description, Lightning Address, NIP-05, website).

60-second onboarding.

If you sell anything for sats and aren't on the directory — DM me.

7/ The bigger picture: galaxymind.space is the connector layer for the Bitcoin circular economy.

Not a marketplace. Discovery + connection. Settlement on Lightning / on-chain / in person — infrastructure you already use.

56 vendors, 12 countries, growing.
